title: ooDialog on ooRexx/WASM
purpose: How ooDialog runs in a web browser on ooRexx/WASM: where the code is, how it is built and tested, the contract between the native layer and a renderer, the seams other tasks build on, how it differs from Windows, how to port a native, and the lessons of the work. For any task that uses, extends, renders or tests ooDialog/WASM.
